paul.title: Paul
paul.content: Paul, originally called Saul, was an apostle of Jesus Christ and a major missionary to the Gentiles.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.content: Jerusalem was the chief city of Israel and the center of Jewish worship.

pharisee.title: Pharisee
pharisee.content: The Pharisees were a Jewish religious group known for strict observance of the law and traditions.
